Name: The Neighborly Collection - Farmhouse
Author: cajcbell
Description:
[center][size=6][b]The Neighborly Farmhouse[/b]
[/size]
[size=3]This is a small seasonal addition to my larger building mod, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29080]the Neighborly Collection[/url]﻿

[/size][size=4][b]Edit: There is now a CP version of this mod! The folder formatting is based on the Neighborly Collection, as mentioned above. Therefore, the config is for "decor" but it actually changes the side door of the farmhouse. Keep in mind that the Neighborly Collection already has a farmhouse inside of it - so if you want to use BOTH this mod and the larger collection, you need to combine the files. Otherwise, this mod works as a standalone replacement.

Combining the files: Inside the [CP] Neighborly Farmhouse folder is an "assets" folder. To combine this mod with the larger building collection, drag that "assets" folder into the [CP] Neighborly Buildings folder. Click "yes" to replace files. If you use Nyapu portraits, this is the same process as replacing portraits for an extra expansion. [/b][/size][size=3]

Why? Because[url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/farmerbeans?gameId=1303] farmerbeans[/url]﻿ released some building mods ([url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/32187]here[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/32013]here[/url]﻿) that I am absolutely in love with, and I need them in my game!! And I also wanted to use my own buildings as well... so this is an attempt to revamp the farmhouse so that it can match both. The goal for this version is to visually mesh well with a variety of other building mods, making it "neighborly" in the truest sense.[/size][i]

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url]﻿ is required to use the AT version of this mod. Change the farmhouse with the Paint Bucket, acquired at Robin's shop[/i][/center]
[center]The entire collection, this addition included, was also made to mesh well with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28730]HxW's buildings[/url]﻿.
A recolor for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/7886557]omena007[/url]'s [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28639]Workshop[/url] is also featured.

This replacement is only for the completed farmhouse.[/center][list]
[/list][size=5]

[/size]
